title: 基于文体特征的轻量级LLM生成代码检测
summary: 本文提出一种轻量级方法检测LLM生成的代码，通过设计比率特征、解析引擎和代码-文本行分类器，结合决策树与启发式规则，仅需CPU即可实现快速推理，为SemEval-2026任务13提供高效替代方案。
summary_en: This paper presents a lightweight method for detecting LLM-generated code using ratio-based features, parsing engines, and a code-vs-text line classifier combined with decision trees and heuristic rules, achieving fast CPU-only inference for SemEval-2026 Task 13.
